items.title: Loren Schoenberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: as soon as I started checking out your Buddy DeFranco interview it sent me to 15 records of his

ctx.x: If I can interview you for our archives. MR. Okay.

Because your archive is unique, and as I told you before, we filmed and I think it’s the second time I’m using the word unctuous, but I’m not trying to be unctuous but you know what you’ve done consistently for a quarter of a century is invaluable and unique. Yes there are other archives or other interviews and we all know them. But you have create a finite thing based on what seems to be your personal thing with the people that you interview somehow, and some of them I can tell you are friends with and some…
